step1_figure.circuit_type: Diff-amp with a current mirror load
step1_figure.description: An NMOS differential pair (M1, M2) biased by an NMOS cascode tail current source (xm6t, xm6b) with a PMOS current mirror active load (M3, M4) providing single-ended voltage output.

max_output_voltage.description: Maximum output voltage before the PMOS load transistor M4 enters the triode region

equation.explanation: Limited by keeping PMOS load M4 in saturation; above this level, M4 moves into triode.
equation.assumptions: M4 operating in saturation with drain-source saturation overdrive voltage VSD,sat.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming ID4 = 20 uA, (W/L)p = 20, up*Cox = 50 uA/V^2: VSD,sat = sqrt(2*ID / (up*Cox * W/L)) = sqrt(40u / (50u * 20)) = 0.20 V. VOUTMAX = 1.8 V - 0.20 V = 1.60 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With 1.8 V VDD in SKY130 and PMOS overdrive of approximately 150 to 250 mV, VOUTMAX is around 1.6 V.

min_output_voltage.description: Minimum output voltage before input transistor M2 enters the triode region

equation.explanation: The output node is the drain of M2. For M2 to remain saturated, VD2 >= VG2 - VTHN.
equation.assumptions: M2 gate held at VI2 = 1.44 V, accounting for threshold voltage with body effect.

sky130_expected.calculation: For VI2 = 1.44 V: with nominal VTHN0 = 0.42 V and body effect increasing VTHN to ~0.65 V at VSB ~ 0.5 V: VOUTMIN = 1.44 V - 0.65 V = 0.79 V (without body effect: 1.44 - 0.42 = 1.02 V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Accounting for body effect on NMOS input pair as explained in Ex. 22.3, the minimum output drops to ~0.8 V.

max_cm_input_voltage.description: Maximum common-mode input voltage that keeps the NMOS differential pair in saturation

equation.explanation: The drain of M1 is clamped at VDD - VSG3. For M1 to remain in saturation, VD1 >= VG1 - VTHN.
equation.assumptions: Balanced input conditions with equal split of tail current.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The common-mode input can approach VDD within ~200 mV before the diff-pair enters triode.

min_cm_input_voltage.description: Minimum common-mode input voltage required to keep tail current source and diff-pair in saturation

equation.explanation: Sum of gate-source voltage of the input diff-pair plus minimum compliance voltage of the cascode tail source (2 * VDS,sat).
equation.assumptions: Cascode tail current source requires 2*VDS,sat to maintain high output impedance.

sky130_expected.calculation: VGS1,2 = VTHN + Vov,n = 0.50 V + 0.12 V = 0.62 V (without body effect) or ~0.75 V with body effect. Tail cascode drop = 2 * 0.15 V = 0.30 V. VCMMIN = 0.75 V + 0.30 V = 1.05 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Requires sufficient headroom to support cascode tail devices plus input VGS.

min_power_supply_voltage.description: Minimum allowable supply voltage VDDmin for proper saturation operation of all stacked devices

equation.explanation: Calculated by stacking the diode drop VSG3 of the PMOS mirror load, VDS,sat of input transistor M1, and 2*VDS,sat of the cascode tail source.
equation.assumptions: All transistors maintain minimum saturation overdrive voltages.

sky130_expected.reasoning: In 130 nm CMOS, supply voltages down to ~1.0 V support this active-loaded cascode topology.

differential_input_range.description: Maximum differential input voltage for current steering between M1 and M2

equation.formula: v_di,max = sqrt(2 * L * ISS / (KPn * W)) = sqrt(2) * (VGS - VTHN)
equation.explanation: The maximum input differential voltage above which all tail current ISS is steered entirely into one branch.
equation.assumptions: Square-law saturation model for NMOS input pair.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Differential steering range corresponds to sqrt(2)*Vov,n, typically 150 to 200 mV.

step3_testbench.description: Ngspice testbench characterizing the differential amplifier with current mirror load: DC sweep of VI1 around VI2 (1.44V) to measure output swing (VOUTMAX, VOUTMIN) and switching characteristics, followed by common-mode DC sweep to verify input common-mode range (VCMMIN, VCMMAX).
